definitions.explanation: A state of being easily moved to tender, sad, or nostalgic emotions. Can imply excessive or self-indulgent emotion.

examples.japanese: {感傷|かんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧。
{感傷|かんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}され→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: Judge calmly without being swept away by sentimentality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{感傷|かんしょう}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone gets sentimental during graduation season.

notes:
{感傷|かんしょう} refers to tender, nostalgic emotions.

USAGE:
- Can be neutral (natural emotional sensitivity)
- Can be slightly negative (excessive, self-indulgent emotion)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {感傷|かんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧: to indulge in sentimentality
- {感傷|かんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to be swept away by sentiment
- {感傷|かんしょう}{的|てき}: sentimental (na-adjective)
- {感傷|かんしょう}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: sentimentalism
